Definition: properly, a heap, i.e. a sheaf; also an omer, as a dry measure
BiblicalUsage: Omer is a measure, an omer of grain, and a sheaf of the firstfruits. In Exodus 16:16 every man gathers an omer of manna according to his eating, and in Leviticus 23:10 the sheaf of the firstfruits is brought to the priest when Israel reaps the harvest.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the omer teaches that God measures His provision by the eater, and the first sheaf belongs to Him before the harvest is eaten.
RelatedEvents: Manna and Quail in the Wilderness
